captions.detailed: An indoor pedestal-column CCTV camera with a decorative, rounded light-grey base and a short supporting column. It features a translucent grey dome housing suspended from a flat circular top cap. Inside the protective dome, a dark grey camera assembly is mounted to a bracket, allowing it to pan continuously and tilt vertically via internal mechanical joints.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a pedestal-column interior CCTV camera. The assembly should feature a rounded decorative base, a vertical column post, a flat top cap, a translucent dome housing, and an internal dark camera bracket and lens assembly that can pan and tilt.
captions.factory: The code defines an ArticulatedObject constructed from 3D primitives. It creates a pedestal base and post using a Cylinder and a decorative rounded base shape. A flat cylindrical top cap is modeled, along with a translucent dome housing. The internal camera mechanics are constructed from box and cylinder primitives representing the mounting bracket, a panning rotor, and a tiltable camera body with a lens. These components are linked together using continuous (pan) and revolute (tilt) articulations.
